internal.note: CRITICAL: macOS swap lives here. ~9.6 GB free means almost no swap headroom — any config that spills to swap is dangerous on this machine. The memory-safety ceiling is set by this, not by the 32 GB RAM alone.

external_ssd.note: Holds all model weights/caches. exFAT cannot host a pip venv (AppleDouble ._* poisons pip metadata) — weights only.

compute.label: MEASURED
compute.gpu_mlx_elementwise_bandwidth_note: Measured floor from a single elementwise pass; M1 Pro spec peak is ~200 GB/s. Decode is bandwidth-bound, so the effective figure under real GEMV matters more than this microbench.
compute.gpu_mlx_4bit_vecmat_note: 4096x4096 4-bit weight (~8.4 MB) vec-mat in 0.214 ms => ~39 GB/s effective resident 4-bit weight read during decode. This is the RESIDENT-weight decode ceiling to compare SSD streaming against.

external_ssd_io.label: MEASURED (cold)
external_ssd_io.method: F_NOCACHE is a no-op on the exFAT/USB driver and purge needs sudo, so cache was defeated structurally with a 40 GiB test file (> 32 GB RAM): random battery read first (earlier regions already evicted by the write stream), then a full sequential pass. A naive 4 GiB run reported 10-80 GB/s — that was the page cache, discarded.
external_ssd_io.effective_ceiling_note: Random read saturates at ~1.0-1.1 GB/s for >=1 MiB blocks (USB SATA-class SSD). This is the HARD bound on MoE expert streaming: max tok/s = ~1.0e9 / (bytes read from SSD per token). Latency grows linearly with block size (1 MiB ~1.5 ms, 64 MiB ~76 ms) so many small expert reads per token stack up.

implications.ssd_streaming_bound: At ~1 GB/s cold random read, a model that must fetch R bytes/token from SSD is capped at ~1.0e9/R tok/s. e.g. 1.7 GB/token (gpt-oss-120b MXFP4) => ~0.6 tok/s (below the 2 tok/s stop condition).
implications.resident_vs_streamed_gap: ~39 GB/s resident 4-bit weight read vs ~1 GB/s SSD => resident is ~40x faster. The dominant lever is fitting the model in RAM (mixed quantization), not streaming.
implications.swap_danger: Only ~9.6 GB free on the internal swap volume => keep the wired/resident set well under ~22 GB and never drive into swap.
